question: Should this PR land with identical mock voice-call webhook request material treated as a 10-minute replay, matching the shared provider replay window?
rationale: The code path is coherent and proven, but the mock provider behavior now suppresses repeated identical local-test side effects during the replay window, which is a maintainer-visible merge choice.

options.title: Accept bounded mock replay semantics
options.body: Merge with the explicit behavior that repeated identical mock webhook payloads are acknowledged without side effects until the replay window expires.

options.title: Clarify local test payload guidance
options.body: Ask for a short PR-body or test note explaining that local tests needing repeated side effects must vary request material or wait for expiry.

options.title: Pause for different mock semantics
options.body: Hold the PR if maintainers want the mock provider to satisfy the request-key gate without suppressing repeated identical payloads.

recommendation.title: Accept bounded mock replay semantics
recommendation.body: Merge with the explicit behavior that repeated identical mock webhook payloads are acknowledged without side effects until the replay window expires.
